name: Over 40 Billion Light Years to See You
summary: It tells the story of Tang Meng Yan, a blue star woman 40 billion light-years away, who has conducted civilized exploration on the earth in accordance with the mission of the alien trade union for 100 years. When she was about to leave the earth, she met Ye Chen Feng, her lover from the previous life, and the two continued their relationship, but she had to return to Blue Star with only 10 days left. Ten years later, Tang Meng Yan returned to Earth from Blue Star and lived a peaceful life in the teahouse with Ye Chen Feng. This time, how far can their love go?

name: Fall in Love with NPC
summary: "Let's fall in love", as a love development game, attracts a large number of players with male god NPCs with unbelievable looks and different personalities. However, with the frequent occurrence of bugs in the "Love it" game, the male god NPC not only violates the settings, but even hurts the players. Fans abandoned the pit, players complained, and the company decided to completely delete all the data of the game. As the founder of the game, Yan Wei couldn't bear to "love it" just disappear, and decided to enter the game in person to find bugs…

name: Mafia The Series: Guns & Freaks
summary: Beam, a regular university student, found himself in the middle of Mafia war after finding out that his recently passed away father, Rachen, was the head of Nemesis, the most powerful crime organization in the country. Complicating matters further is when Rachen's personal bodyguard, the world's best assassin, THE WORLD CLASS hacker, and an ex-mercenary came to Beam's house in order to protect him from their enemies. With different backgrounds and goals, THE GANG twisted Beam's life in the most unimaginable way. One only wanted to protect Beam. Another one wanted Beam to follow the footstep of his father to become the leader of NEMESIS. As time want by, the gang and Beam started to develop bonds. A relationship between brothers, sisters, or even the feeling of being parent and child. Even a heartless assassin started to develop the feeling of love.

name: Old Enough!
summary: Children go on errands all by themselves for the very first time as a camera crew follows along in this beloved, long-running reality show from Japan.

name: Bride of Beirut
summary: Living with her aunt, kind-hearted Thourayya leads a simple life, but her world is upended when she crosses paths with the handsome and ambitious Fares.

name: The Fast History Of
summary: The Fast History Of is a super-charged romp through the histories of anything from iconic brands like Nike, Domino's and Nintendo to enthralling topics like The Mob, UFOs and The Secret Lives of Billionaires. From the very beginning through today, it's all the surprising, eye-opening and innovative moments that make up their stories....delivered in 30 minutes or less!

name: Snapphanar
summary: Snapphanar is a Swedish miniseries which aired in three parts on Sveriges Television during Christmas 2006, directed by Måns Mårlind and Björn Stein. The historical drama is about the Snapphane peasant rebel movement which fought against the Swedish rule of Scania in the 17th century. The "Snapphanar" was a rebellion people, who fought secretly for Denmark during 1660-1700. The miniseries were criticised by historians due to a perceived lack of historical accuracy. The Scanian nationalist attitudes portrayed in the series did not exist in the 17th century, and the term snapphane, which is used for self-identification in the series, was in fact a derogatory term used by Swedes.

name: Ore no Kawaii wa Mousugu Shouhikigen!?
summary: The story features two people who experience their first loves late in life. Maruya Kosuke is a 29-year-old employee at a beer manufacturer who works in the sales department and comes from a rich family that owns a brewery. Since he was young, he has been popular thanks to his good looks and always receives confessions of love from women. However, he gets a rude awakening one day when he realizes that his cuteness has an expiration date. Sanada Izumi works as a researcher in the same company as Kosuke and always thinks of herself as being secondary to others due to a past experience.

name: Celebrity Rebrand
summary: Chaotic celebrity interview series hosted by Amelia Dimoldenberg, who attempts to give some of Channel 4's biggest stars the rebrand they don't need.

name: Married to a Psychopath
summary: The story of the hunt for murderer Malcolm Webster, who targetted wealthy women for their money.

name: Yae no Sakura
summary: Niijima Yae, who grew up in the Aizu domain, was a spunky girl despite her mother's wishes that she be feminine. Because of anecdotes of how she barricaded herself with 500 women in Tsuruga Castle while being besieged during the Boshin War, and fought with guns, she was acclaimed as the "Joan of Arc of the late Edo period". After the Meiji Restoration, she became the wife of Niijima Jo (Odagiri Joe), who had returned from America. She soon joined the Sino-Japanese War and Russo-Japanese War together with her Aizu comrades as Japan's first volunteer nurses, going from warrior woman to Japan's Nightingale.

name: Queen: A Rock History
summary: Simon Callow narrates a documentary examining the rise to fame of the rock band, revealing their early attempts to break into the charts and Freddie Mercury's blossoming as a front man as he created his stage persona.

name: Dogs with Extraordinary Friends
summary: Dogs aren't only man's best friend - they can be friends with other animals like monkeys, birds and even dolphins.

name: Jay Blades: No Place Like Home
summary: The Repair Shop's Jay Blades returns to his childhood neighbourhood of Hackney to discover the extraordinary history that was on his doorstep, meeting locals, historians and old friends as he explores the place he thought he knew so well, and discovers there is often much more than meets the eye.

name: Mimi's World
summary: Children's drama in which an inspirational childminder who summons up magical characters to help kids to deal with their feelings through stories, songs and adventures.

name: Tropenjaren
summary: In Tropical Years, Jelle and Rosa start a new phase in their lives. The young parents not only try to do the best for their daughter Stella, but also try to continue their working life and relationship as it always was: sexy and ambitious. But going out and partying now seem to be making way for diapers and babysitters.

name: Tiny Oz
summary: Comedian Jimmy Rees and tiny craft artist JoAnne Bouzianis-Sellick unite with the extraordinary crafts people of Australia to re-create remarkable moments from our nation's history, in glorious miniature.

name: Stars à domicile
summary: Its purpose was to stage and film the meeting of a public figure (singers for the most part) with one of his admirers, to the surprise of the latter, generally in a place that is familiar to him such as his home, with the complicity of his relatives. For each meeting, five per evening, the program alternated a portrait of the admirer drawn up by testimonies from his relatives, with reports on the preparations for the meeting, then the meeting itself. Finally, the celebrity, his admirer, and his close accomplices of the show, found themselves on set, it was the scene of L'Olympia, or in a setting imitating this one, installed in a studio of the House Radio with host Flavie Flament to talk about the meeting.

name: Les hautes herbes
summary: After his mother's terrible car accident, Jules (10), is fostered for the summer by a young couple who lives in a small and uneventful village in the countryside. However, the mysterious disappearance of one of the inhabitants sheds a light on well-kept secrets and old rancour.

name: Damoiselle
summary: What if beauty YouTubers had always existed? In ancient Egypt, in the Middle Ages, in occupied Gaul, these "Damsels" share in front of the camera their beauty tutorials which remove make-up from History! A grating glimpse into the condition of women over the centuries.

name: Neufs mecs
summary: Victor, a musician, is planning a tour with his ex-girlfriend, with whom he is still very much in love; Simon has decided to introduce his fiancée to his mother who is absolutely convinced that he is gay; Martin, perfectly bilingual, pretends to need English lessons because he is in love with his teacher; Thomas, the osteopath on the ground floor is stuck on his divorce and is stuck on his back...

name: C'était la guerre d'Algérie
summary: July 1962, Algeria is independent. Millions across the country celebrate the birth of a nation and the end of 130 years of French presence. A million others, Europeans, called the "pieds-noirs", born in Algeria, rooted for generations left the country in a dramatic exodus.

name: Visitors
summary: It's Richard's first day on the force. At nightfall, two strange lights collide in the sky...

name: Les reines de la route
summary: Seven women, passionate about their job as truck drivers, share their daily lives in the heart of the roads of France and Europe. They travel hundreds of kilometers at the wheel of their XXL trucks: 44 tons, the biggest gauges on the road. Every day they have to accomplish a new mission: load huge cargoes and deliver them on time. This race against the clock sometimes takes place in extreme conditions: snow, fog, mechanical problems... But nothing stops our queens of the road! Without ever renouncing their femininity and their sentimental and family life, they break the codes to live their love of the truck! More than a passion, this road job is a vocation.

name: The Booze, Bets and Sex That Built America
summary:
From the time the United States was founded, there's been a battle for the nation's very soul. On one side, the forces who believe individuals have the right and freedom to enjoy every indulgence. On the other, those who believe some indulgences to be evil and others to be legislated out of existence. And the nation at large takes sides, and sometimes changes sides. Over the course of nearly a hundred years, the fight over alcohol, tobacco, gambling and sex will define the American cultural experience, and help the country come of age. Bold pioneers like Jack Daniel, Adolphus Busch, Buck Duke and Julius Schmid will bring these controversial products out of the shadows and into the mainstream, and build some of the biggest commercial empires in American history. Then, a new generation of visionaries will also lay the groundwork for the state lottery system, the Sexual Revolution and Sin City itself…

Each two-hour episode is packed with scintillating historical facts, riveting drama and compelling characters who operate on both sides of the law. It's a little dangerous, a little taboo, and a lot of fun.

name: My Dear Rescuer
summary: Khwan, an emergency responder with a special gift, helps Petch, a cool police officer, to solve mysterious cases.

name: Fairwood
summary: Two quirky entertainers with an upbeat, family-oriented philosophy are unexpectedly thrust into the limelight as hosts of their own TV show just as an evil corporation begins taking over their small town.

previousepisode.name: Fight the Man, Kill the Plan

name: Overlord and the Underwoods
summary: An evil overlord, fleeing from his home planet, takes refuge with a distant earth cousin and her suburban family. Comic adventures ensue.

name: Guilty Minds
summary: Guilty Minds is a legal drama about one family that is the paragon of virtue and the other, a leading law firm dealing with all shades of grey.

name: Walkabout
summary: Norwegian Road-movie-like tv-serie with Nils Wærstad and Ronny Kristoffersen.

name: We Are Not Brothers
summary: Zu Bo, a young student in Beijing, is a programmer. He loves his work and his daily life is extremely simple. In addition to his work, he stays in the house of his mother, Hui Fang, to study and write code in the early years of Beijing. Zu Bo's quiet life was broken by a phone call from Bo's mother. He was told that his third uncle from his hometown, Guangdong, would come to Beijing to temporarily live in his house. Bo's mother repeatedly stressed that he should receive his third uncle well. Although Zu Bo had long lost his impression of this distant relative, he was still ready to pick up the "old man" at the station with a wheelchair. Unexpectedly, the third uncle in Bo's mother's mouth was actually a young man of the same age as Zu Bo, but because of his seniority, he became an "uncle". Zu Bo was still a little resistant at first. When he heard that his uncle was also a "programmer", he put down his guard and took his uncle home.

name: Beverly Hills Bordello
summary: Nestled in quiet seclusion in the hills above Los Angeles is the house of Madame Veronica Winston (Nicole Gian). Having a reputation second to none, Madame Winston ensures that no matter what the fantasy she will try to make sure that it comes true and every client will enjoy the experience as much as possible!

name: The Really Loud House
summary: This super loud family comedy brings the Loud House family to real life, showcasing brand new stories you've never seen before. Lincoln Loud navigates the chaos of living in a family with 10 sisters with help of his best friend Clyde McBride.

previousepisode.name: A Really Loud Thanksgiving; The Gobble Squabble Debacle

name: I Love Paraisópolis
summary: I Love Paraisópolis, by Alcides Nogueira and Mario Teixeira, is set especially in São Paulo. Paraisópolis is a slum neighborhood in the city of São Paulo, belonging to the district of Vila Andrade, located in the south zone of São Paulo, with the core direction of Wolf Maya and general direction of Wolf Maya and Carlos Araújo. The colors of the clustered houses in the region contrast with the skyscrapers of the luxury neighborhood of Morumbi and form one of the largest communities in São Paulo with around 100,000 inhabitants and one million square meters, located in the south of the city. It is in this bustling scenario that the story of Marizete or Mari (Bruna Marquezine) and Pandora or Danda (Tatá Werneck), residents of Paraisópolis, takes place. Mari and Danda are "friends-sisters" and together they live a thousand adventures and many other problems that seem to follow them wherever they go. They are young people who want a better life and struggle to achieve their dreams. As if by fate, Mari meets Benjamin (Mauricio Destri), a resident of Morumbi and an award-winning architect who returns from New York to carry out his great project: the redevelopment of Paraisópolis. Despite being committed to Margot (Maria Casadeval), Benjamin falls in love with Mari and together they face everything and everyone to live that love.

name: Ancient Earth: Dinosaurs of the Frozen Continent
summary: Antarctica went through greenhouse epochs before it eventually succumbed to ice again. The great mystery is how the animals and plant life evolved and survived in a strange polar seasonal world of months of darkness.

name: Grace
summary: This is a story about a family man who succumbs to weakness and his failure to live a moral life condemns those he loves to an unspeakable horror. Only his path to redemption can save them.

name: Te la dedico
summary: Adriana and Wilson, two singers united by destiny, love and their careers, star in a story of encounters and disagreements through music, singing and spite.

name: Coral Triangle
summary: An oceanographic expedition explores the depths of the Coral Triangle reef, a Pacific Ocean wonder that dominates Australia's marine ecosystems.

name: The Pride of the Family
summary: Albie works in advertising for a newspaper and is full of innovative ideas that don't quite work. He goes home to his devoted wife Catherine, 15 year old daughter Ann, and son Junior who is 14.

name: Spiky Gold Hunters
summary: Spiky Gold Hunters follows six courageous, rough, tough, and charismatic characters as they battle the tempestuous elements of Southern New Zealand to deliver the gastronomic equivalent of diamonds to fine diners around the globe – sea urchin! This six part one hour series is not for the faint-hearted – and nor is the environment these divers work in. Foveaux Strait is prone to vicious storms, big swells and ever changing weather conditions and on top of that, the divers have to overcome freezing temperatures and the inherent threat of shark attacks.

name: Bloody Murray
summary: Murray and Dana are lifelong friends and roommates who share one unlucky commonality — they're both still single and approaching their late 30s. Dana is an accomplished gynecologist, though she has yet to start a family of her own; Murray is a witty and cynical film lecturer obligated to teach a seminar on romantic comedy this semester. Living together eases the anxiety that comes with being aging bachelorettes, but the drama of their lives unfortunately ends up mirroring that of the films discussed in Murray's class. When Murray gets into a car accident and escapes from the scene, she never imagines she would see the handsome stranger with whom she collided ever again. But sure enough, this mystery man discovers her identity, tracks her down, and arrives at her home — only to meet and immediately become enamored with her best friend.

name: The Every
summary: The Every follows the world's largest tech company when merges with the planet's dominant e-commerce site, creating the richest and most dangerous – and, oddly enough, the most beloved – monopoly ever known: The Every.

name: The U.S. and the Holocaust
summary:
The U.S. and the Holocaust explores America's response to one of the greatest humanitarian crises in history. It is partly inspired by the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum's "Americans and the Holocaust" exhibition and supported by its historical resources. The film examines the rise of Hitler and Nazism in Germany in the context of global antisemitism and racism, the eugenics movement in the United States, and race laws in the American south. The series sheds light on what the U.S. government and American people knew and did as the catastrophe unfolded in Europe.

Americans consider themselves a "nation of immigrants." Still, as the catastrophe of the Holocaust unfolded in Europe, the United States proved unwilling to open its doors to more than a fraction of the hundreds of thousands of desperate people seeking refuge. Through riveting firsthand testimony of witnesses and survivors who, as children, endured persecution, violence, and flight as their families tried to escape Hitler, this series delves deeply into the tragic human consequences of public indifference, bureaucratic red tape, and restrictive quota laws in America. Did the nation fail to live up to its ideals? This is a history with which to be reckoned.

Combining the first-person accounts of Holocaust witnesses and survivors and interviews with leading historians and writers, this series dispels competing myths that Americans either were ignorant of the unspeakable persecution that Jews and other targeted minorities faced in Europe or that they looked on with callous indifference. The film tackles a range of questions that remain essential to our society today, including how racism influences policies related to immigration and refugees, as well as how governments and people respond to the rise of authoritarian states that manipulate history and facts to consolidate power.

name: Augustine: The Decline of the Roman Empire
summary: This 2010 two-part television miniseries is chronicling the life of St. Augustine, the early Christian theologian, writer and Bishop of Hippo Regius at the time of the Vandal invasion (AD 430).

name: Wara
summary: Fifty-something Moutari Warra is a top law professor, teaching at the university of his adopted hometown, Tanasanga. He shares much of his private life with the rector Ganka Barry, their passion for horse-racing making them close friends. Through Ganka he meets Félicité, who becomes his wife and with whom he has a daughter, Didjé. At the university, the best students flock to his classes, drawn by his charisma and his specilisation in constitutional law. A special relationship develops between him and his best student, the young and bright Aïcha Diallo. But their professor-student relationship is not an easy one, beset as it is by a generational and conflictual mismatch.

name: Dora
summary: Now there's more to explore with DORA! Join the iconic exploradora in amazing adventures with friends old and new as she journeys across the wacky and wonderful Rainforest with her best friend Boots by her side.

name: Dertigers
summary: A close group of friends in their thirties shares the joys and sorrows of a common trauma, surrounded by secrets.

name: I Bought a Dump ... Now What?
summary: Three duos put their relationships to the test as they invest everything to renovate the most-dilapidated homes they can find. Brave but naive, these pairs struggle to make difficult decisions, stay on budget and stay together.

name: Woori the Virgin
summary: Oh Woo Ri, a woman who kept her virginal purity, getting pregnant with a child of Raphael, the CEO of a cosmetic group, due to the doctor's mistake during a regular check-up.

name: Журов
summary: Zhurov is an unlucky but very experienced detective. He travels everywhere in his old Pobeda, brings up his daughter alone, likes to drink and has a very vague amorous relationship with his colleague. All this does not prevent him from masterfully revealing the most complex and intricate cases, for which, apart from him, no one else dares to take on.

name: MaveriX
summary: Six young motocross riders come together to form a team, to make the national titles, or crash out trying. But the biggest win of all might be the friends they make for life.

name: True Colors
summary: True Colors was an early 90's sitcom from FOX television that centered around the blending of families between an interracial couple. Ron Freeman and Ellen Davis marry, therefore creating a multitude of episodes centering around their new expanded family. Ron had two sons from his previous marriage, Lester and Terry Freeman, and Ellen had one daughter, Katie. Add the antics of Ellen's mother Sara, played by Nancy Walker and you have a full-fledged family focusing and trying to adjust to a common problem in everyday life looking beyond the exterior to learn about the interior. The show struggled with ratings and managed to last for two seasons. Frankie Faison played Ron Freeman in the first season, and Cleavon Little joined the cast as dad #2 until the sitcom's abrupt demise in 1992.

name: Battle Kitty
summary: Kitty and Orc brawl with monsters, beat out rivals — and need your help to move through Battle Island and become champion in this interactive adventure!

name: The Wind Blows From Longxi
summary: During the war between Wei and Shu, the Shu defeated the Wei using the crossbows they make. In order to attain this powerful weapon, the Wei sent numerous spies to infiltrate the Shu kingdom and steal it. Chen Gong and Xun Xu are Shu spies who have infiltrated Wei kingdom for many years. After knowing the plan of Wei, they decided to work separately to stop it. Chen Gong continued to stay in Wei kingdom, while Xun Xu went back to Shu kingdom to investigate. In the midst of investigation, Xun Xu finds out the thief of the crossbows - Mei Chong. He also discovers a highly skilled spy named Zhu Long who is ambushed in Shu kingdom, who is waiting for the opportunity to initiate the Qing Ping plan. Xun Xu devised a scheme to hook Mei Chong, using it as an opportunity to destroy the spy network in Shu kingdom.

name: Norges sprekeste
summary: Reality series where ten pensioners between the ages of 68 and 77 compete for who is the most active. They live together in a holiday colony, and participate in physical, challenging competitions. Finally one of them is left!

name: Mordbrannen
summary: True crime about a fire in Oslo, Norway leading to the death of six residents.

name: Young Swingers
summary: You're young, you're good looking - a real catch. And you thought swinging was for bored, middle-aged suburbanites? Think again...

name: Iveta
summary:
Iveta wants to be a famous singer. The journey leads from the children's choir through singing competitions, recording the first hit and record to nationwide fame. Iveta has to convince parents, jurors, producers, spectators. The only one who believes in her from the beginning is Petr Sepéši. Her first love. 

What is the price of a dream come true? The beginning of Iveta Bartošová's life story.

name: Eve
summary: A romance drama dealing with the inside story of a chaebol's 2 trillion won (approximately $1.7 billion) divorce lawsuit that shocks the entire nation.

name: Rock Island Mysteries
summary: Taylor and her group of friends are living what seems to be the perfect island life with sun-soaked beaches and jungle-like hinterlands. But underneath that perfect facade lies a hotbed of cryptic riddles, thrilling legends, and unexplainable mysteries waiting to be unravelled. Fuelled by her fascination with her Uncle Charlie's disappearance five years earlier, Taylor is the determined leader in pursuit of the truth. Alongside Taylor, there's Nori, a wisecracking rebel who's got an answer for everything; Meesha, a toughas-nails sports nut who's up for anything; Ellis, a hypochondriac who's the brains of the group; and Taylor's stepsister Lila, an aspiring vlogger who adores her older sister. With a determination to leave no stone unturned, the five best friends jump head first into a series of intriguing mysteries and nail-biting adventures through ancient caves, remote islands and eerie jungles.

name: Hot Cakes
summary: Series following the lives and loves of the baking entrepreneurs behind one of the UK's most inspirational insta-bakeries, situated in the heart of Cardiff.

name: Darren McGarvey's Addictions
summary: Darren McGarvey explores why Scotland is the most addicted country in Europe.

name: Commando: Britain's Ocean Warriors
summary: What does it take to wear the green beret? Hair-raising moments in extreme locations test the marines to their limits - can they walk in the footsteps of their heroes?

name: Britain's Top Takeaways
summary: Cooking show in which five different takeaway restaurants compete for the top prize.

name: The Last Summoner
summary: A talented young cook's encounter with a hungry girl who popped up in his kitchen changes his ordinary life forever. Dora, a summoned spirit and a truly cute goddess, now calls him master. However, he is not interested at all and trying everything he could to get away from the ghostly figure. As fate would have it, when he becomes a summoner by accident, there is no turn back in life.

name: The Man Without a Heart
summary: The story of the death of Miguel Ángel Martínez, looking into the unsolved case and the death of his sister, who was also found dead floating in a fjord in Stockholm.

name: Odznak Vysočina
summary: There is no shortage of mysteries in the beautiful environment of Vysočina. A team of investigators is led by an experienced policewoman Dana Skálová (Monika Hilmerová). She understands people and always tries to help. She doesn't like to be limited by rules and customs. She lives a bit in chaos, does not deal with paperwork and sometimes goes late, but her work is always in the first place for her. Unlike Dana, her colleague Kateřina Vlčková (Simona Zmrzlá) is very pedantic, respects the rules, loves order and the system. Shee is constantly supplementing his education, studying new methods and procedures.

name: Welcome to Wedding Hell
summary: A romantic drama about a couple of 30-year-olds preparing for a wedding. While they were expecting a happy ending, as in a fairy tale, the reality of their preparations turns out to be somewhat different.

name: Blood Sisters
summary: Bound by a dangerous secret, best friends Sarah and Kemi are forced to go on the run after a wealthy groom disappears during his engagement party.

name: Los Protectores
summary: Three representatives of soccer players, completely different from each other, are forced to team up to save their businesses.

name: Croí na Ceiste le Caoimhe
summary: Broadcaster and journalist Caoimhe Ní Chathail investigates the growing issues affecting young people today.

name: Drive TV
summary: Take the road less travelled and discover an all-new great Australian road trip with the team from Drive. Breathtaking locations and local stories from the front seat of the best cars in Australia today. Get off-the-grid and off-the-map as we set out to prove there is an epic Australian Drive for every type of driver.

name: Oussekine
summary: On the night of 5 December 1986, 22-year-old French-Algerian student Malik Oussekine was beaten to death by the police. The state machine steps into gear, led by Robert Pandraud. The Oussekine family quickly realise that they will have to fight for justice and to expose the truth. Oussekine is a four-episode miniseries about the Oussekine family's struggle. It goes back through the events, shows their hopes and disillusions and paints the portrait of a country in turmoil.

name: We Were the Lucky Ones
summary: Based on Georgia Hunter's New York Times bestselling novel, the television adaptation of We Were the Lucky Ones is a limited series inspired by the incredible true story of one Jewish family separated at the start of World War II, determined to survive and reunite. We Were the Lucky Ones demonstrates how in the face of the twentieth century's darkest moment, the human spirit can endure and even thrive. The series is a tribute to the triumph of hope and love against all odds.

name: Celebrity Catchpoint
summary: Paddy McGuinness hosts the show with the biggest balls on telly.

previousepisode.name: Kadeena Cox, Perri Shakes-Drayton, Shirlie Kemp, Martin Kemp

name: The State Opening of Parliament
summary: Coverage from the Palace of Westminster of the State Opening of Parliament attended by the Queen.

name: The Airport: Back in the Skies
summary: Over four crucial months of the pandemic, aviation expert Jeremy Spake is inside Heathrow to see if they can keep Britain flying during the most challenging time in its history.

name: Darryl Morris
summary: Late Night with Darryl Morris.

name: Shoutai
summary: Kaburagi Keiichi is arrested as a suspect in a murder case and sentenced to death. He escaped from prison during the transfer, but while fleeing, he rescues the people he meets in his hiding place from the predicament. And when the rescued people realize that Kaburagi is a wanted death row prisoner, they begin to wonder, "Is he really a murderer?"

name: Nomad with Carlton McCoy
summary: Carlton McCoy is on a journey of discovery. Join the classically trained chef, master sommelier, and arbiter of cool on his quest to find the places where food, music, art, and culture collide. From the bustling streets of Seoul to the riverside towns along the Mississippi River, this six-part documentary series chases what it means to be authentic, celebrating the similarities and differences across the world to illuminate the universal threads that connect us all. At times deeply personal, McCoy uncovers the wellspring of new ideas, talent, and creation that has formed in some of the world's most well-known destinations.

name: All You Need is Love
summary: Series on the history of modern pop music, directed by Tony Palmer and originally broadcast worldwide between 1976 and 1980. The series covers the many different genres that have fallen under the "pop" label between the mid-1800s and 1976, including folk, ragtime, Tin Pan Alley, vaudeville and music hall, musical theater, country, swing, jazz, blues, R&B, rock 'n' roll and others.

name: Outlaws
summary: Outlaws, debuting on September 29, 1960, was a unique Western in that the stories were told with a dark edge from the point of view of the criminal. The audience was given the rare opportunity to see how the outlaws thought, how and why they plotted their crime, and their perspective on being caught. The show was also more historically accurate than most Westerns of the time, featuring actual outlaws such as The Dalton Gang, Bill Doolin, and Sam Bass. The first season of Outlaws starred Barton McLane as Chief United States Marshal Frank Caine, Don Collier as Deputy Marshal Will Foreman, and Jock Gaynor as Will's nephew, Deputy Marsall Heck Martin. Deputy Martin disappered after the 9th episode (with no explanation) and Will's new partner was Deputy Steve Corbie, played by Wynn Pearce. The second season of Outlaws brought many changes. The stories were now like other Westerns; told from the the point of view of the Marshal. The setting moved from Guthrie, Oklahoma to Stillwat.

name: Master of My Own
summary: For as long as she can remember, Ning Meng has dreamt of becoming an investment director, but since graduation, she seems to be drifting farther and farther from that dream. Currently working at an investment firm under Lu Ji Ming, Ning Meng has never once been given a chance to advance in her career. Believing Ning Meng doesn't have what it takes to become a qualified investor, Lu Ji Ming keeps her stuck in a dead-end job.

name: Домашнее поле
summary: When the provincial football club Krasny Yastreb is left without a coach before the start of the season in the Russian Premier League, its CEO Anton Danin, bypassing sponsors, appoints Elena Volkova, a talented Muscovite who brought her Saigak team to the Champions League, to this position. She is now the first female coach in a men's sport. But in the city Elena is waiting for a cold reception. Because here football is an exclusively male world.

name: Kiken na Aneki
summary: Ito Misaki stars as the number-one cabaret/hostess club girl. Hailing from the Miyazaki countryside, she has been told since her youth that all she has is a beautiful face. Her brilliant younger brother (played by Moriyama Mirai) who aims to become a doctor, is her only pride. For his sake, she is willing to put up with all sorts of hardships in a display of unconditional love.

previousepisode.name: Victory for a woman's pretty face

name: Enka: Gold Rush
summary: Art instructor Kumagai works for a private Osaka high school for girls, but his salary is at a discount to certified teachers. Sakai, the school's chairman, runs the school like his own. One day, Kumagai is approached by music teacher, Naoko and physical education teacher Oyamada who seek to confront Sakai with proof of his wrongdoings and secure their own positions. Things are still going well up to the point they boldly venture into the apartment of Sakai's mistress, Akemi. But after that, Sakai and Akemi disappear. The couple seem to have been kidnapped by the "education consultants" Minowa and Nakao for some reason. Kumagai and Nahoko unwittingly get involved in a scheme to steal the vast amount of gold bars which are Sakai's hidden assets. Who are the real criminals? They deceive and get deceived as a struggle for the gold bars begins around Osaka and Kobe.

name: Keiji no Genba
summary: A drama about a rookie detective who teams up with a veteran detective and develops a good rapport while overcoming difficulties. Keigo starts his new post at a local police station where he partners up with Shoichi, a frigid, yet warm-hearted, detective on the verge of retirement. The drama features how the young detective builds up his career with the veteran and those who are connected with his cases.

name: Meoto Zenzai
summary:
Chyoko is the daughter of Tanekichi and Otatsu , who are poor. Her parents run a fried dishes shop, but are harassed by moneylenders everyday. Chyoko is bright, but hates being poor. One day, Chyoko begins to work as a geisha even though her parents disapprove. Due to her charming personality she becomes a popular geisha. Choyoko also meets Ryukichi, who works at a cosmetics wholesale store.

Ryukichi has lived his life on the wild side and, because of this, his father Hannbei has cut him off from their family. While Ryukichi waits for his father to welcome him back, Ryukichi seduces Chyoko and takes her to a hot-spring inn. The Great Kanto earthquake then strikes and they return to Osaka. Ryukichi and Chyoko rent a small studio apartment. Will their happiness last?

name: Nagi no Oitoma
summary: Oshima Nagi, a shy, quiet girl works as an OL in Tokyo and has a secret office romance with Gamon Shinji. She's constantly reading the atmosphere and trying to accommodate people's moods with her only goal being to pass each day peacefully. This and her colleagues' mistreatment however stresses her out to the point that she collapses from hyperventilation. When she then overhears her boyfriend's badmouthing, she takes harsh consequences: quits her job and moves to a shabby apartment on the outskirts of Tokyo to start her "long vacation". She plans to reexamine and reset her life in order to be happy and also lets out her naturally curly hair, which she's never shown to anyone, not even Gamon Shinji, due to a childhood complex. This is the story of her meeting her new neighbors and how interacting with them helps Nagi to search for her new path in life. And Shinji can't just let her be...

name: Bishoku Tantei Akechi Goro
summary: Akechi Goro is a private investigator and his office is located near Omotesando in Tokyo. He is a big fan of gourmet food. It is very important for Akechi Goro to eat delicious food every day. A housewife visits his office as a client. She suspected her husband had an affair so she asked Akechi Goro for help.

name: Coffee, Mou Ippai Ikaga Deshou
summary: Tetsuhiro Ikeda's script 'How about another cup of coffee' was interesting and I was looking forward to receiving new works every time. It complements the small story of the original and has a lot of coffee bean knowledge. I also dig into the characters of Aoyama, Tairaya, and Kakine, who were undeveloped, but there was no misunderstanding. I wanted to make it into a manga as it is.

previousepisode.name: Tako Coffee opens a new store !?

name: Drag Race Belgique
summary:
After a dazzling first season, the biggest Drag Queen competition returns to brighten up all this greyness.

As mistress of ceremonies, we find Rita Baga who will present for the second year in a row the second season of Drag Race Belgique. At her side, an exceptional duo to find THE best Belgian Drag Queen: the singer Lio and the singer Mustii.

Who better than this trio to guide our Queens towards the coveted Drag Race Belgique Superstar crown? 

The 9 Queens will have to stand out through small and big challenges, lip-syncs and other parades of all kinds and redouble their talent and creativity in the fields of fashion, humour, theatre and song...

name: Stranger Anniversary
summary: A "doppelgangers" website has facilitated the connection between two complete strangers that look like identical twins. Law firm partner Ko Sau-shing tracks down his former lover Yu Fung, whom he has not contacted for ages, online, and Yu Fung is looking for a part-time boyfriend with a similar appearance to him. Sau-shing arbitrarily approaches applicant Mo Kei-nam, who is a dead ringer for him. The duo also covertly agree to swap identities for two weeks. Sau-shing plays the role of Yu Fung's "substitute lover", and deadbeat Kei-nam disguises himself as Sau-shing while simultaneously dealing with his wife Lee Chi-ying and father-in-law Lee Kwun-hang as each and every crisis at the law firm is handled by him. While the identity swapping deadline looms, this pair of lookalikes are eventually shocked to realize their mutual life trajectories are already different from their expectations.

name: Mystery Incorporated
summary:
Mystery Incorporated is a fresh new series designed to tell the story of the characters from Hanna-Barbera's "Scooby-Doo, Where Are You?" with a modern filter for a new generation.

Set in the small town of Coolsville, OH and inspired heavily by shows like "Supernatural", "Riverdale", and the original "Scooby-Doo" cartoons. We enter a world where monsters are real, demons guard every crossroad, and spirits lurk in the dark.

name: King of the Roads
summary: Superbike riders go head to head to prove who is the fastest racer on the road.

name: Zog
summary: Take to the skies with Zog the lovable orange dragon, Doctor Princess Pearl and Sir Gadabout the Great as they soar across the land and care for all their fantastical friends.

name: W Series Motor Racing Highlights
summary: The W Series returns to Channel 4 for the 2022 season.

name: The Andrew Neil Show
summary: Live political discussion show, featuring extended interviews with decision-takers and news-makers from across the political spectrum and analysis, commentary and debate from a regular cast of contributors.

name: Blocco 181
summary: The three boys at the center of the story come from different realities, yet they are linked by something stronger: Bea is a Latin American girl, torn between loyalty to her family and her gang and the desire to change her life; Ludo and Mahdi are two friends united as brothers. The background to the whole story between generational conflicts, female empowerment, ambition and, above all, the struggle for the conquest of power is Block 181, a building complex in the Milanese suburbs that will become the scene of a story of love, of revenge, of freedom and personal affirmation.

name: Les Aventures de Petit Ours brun
summary: A charming little bear cub learns all sorts of lessons as he goes sledding, gets lost at a market, argues with Mommy, picks up his toys and more!

previousepisode.name: Petit Ours Brun casse son jouet

name: Sprung
summary: Sprung follows Jack, a convicted criminal who is determined to change course and reclaim his lost years after serving more than two decades in prison. With no place to live post-release, and a global pandemic bringing the world to a virtual standstill, Jack moves in with his former cellmate Rooster, Rooster's mom Barb, and Jack's former prison girlfriend Gloria. Bound by their marred past and unusual living circumstances, they decide to start righting some of society's wrongs, targeting those people selfishly taking advantage of others during the pandemic.

name: The Elfin's Golden Castle
summary: The relationship between the rebelling Qi Qi and her foster father Lin Huan Zhi is very tense. Qi Qi who is suffering from depression turns to the internet where she gets to know Bao Bao Lan and You Nuo. Although all very different in character, the three girls come to trust and appreciate each other. Meanwhile, band leader and main vocalist Lin Nan Yi also appears in Qi Qi's life.

name: 幸福在一起
summary: The drama tells the story of Gao Zhen Zhen whose parents divorced since she was young, and by chance, she met the rich-second-generation Qiao Jun Hao. At first, they did not get along with one another, however, through going through many challenging situations which life threw, they gradually became more than acquaintances.

name: 天涯热土
summary: It tells the story of a group of young people, led by commando team leader Lin Han Jie and Chen Sheng Ji, who were the first generation of builders and guardians of the rubber forests of Hainan. They fought against hostile forces, contributed to the development of the country and passed on the same values to the next generation.

name: Banjou no Himawari
summary: In 1994, a human skeleton is found in the mountain of Saitama. A shogi game piece is found with the skeleton. The shogi piece was made by a master craftsman. Veteran detective Takeshi and rookie detective Naoya begin to investigate the owner of the shogi piece. Keisuke is a genius professional shogi player. While doing an interview with a shogi magazine, Keisuke recalls his childhood. In 1972, Keisuke was an elementary school student and he lived with his father. His father was violent and did not even give Keisuke a proper meal. Keisuke happened to meet Koichiro, who was a retired teacher. Koichiro was nice to Keisuke and, because of him, Keisuke became fascinated with the game of shogi. Detective Takeshi and Detective Naoya go to see Keisuke. Is Keisuke the killer? Who is the dead person?

name: 40,000 km Kanata no Koi
summary: Astronaut Takamura Soichi is spending a year in space in order to collect data samples that will enable the human race to live comfortably in space. As someone who loathes people and avoids troublesome human relationships, he is happy living alone with the AI Yuri some 400,000 km from earth. Then one day, Soichi has an interview with his ex-girlfriend Ayuhara Sakiko through satellite connection. Their reunion on a computer screen eventually turns into quarrel but it makes him rediscover his feelings. Then Yuri realises that her feelings for Soichi are close to the human love and begins to question the meaning of her own existence. An unexpected love triangle develops between the astronaut, his ex-girlfriend on earth and the AI! In addition, all sorts of problems happen in outer space…

name: My Lovely Bodyguard
summary: Teywan is the CEO of Siam Palace whose life was flat since he only put his efforts into uncovering the murder case of his sister and brother-in-law. Teywan met Sarapee accidentally while he was being hunted by someone. She risked her life to save him. This led Teywan to be impressed in her fighting skills, so he asked her to work as his bodyguard.

name: The Chris & Rosie Ramsey Show
summary: Husband and wife Chris and Rosie are joined by a celebrity couple and star guests to poke fun at life. And they ask the question that kickstarts relationship re-evaluations: what's your beef?

name: Sí lo digo
summary: Samantha Ballentines welcomes former Drag Race queens into her living room to analyze and react to the episodes of Drag Race España.

name: George Carlin's American Dream
summary: George Carlin's American Dream chronicles the life and work of legendary comedian George Carlin. Dubbed the "dean of counterculture comedians," Carlin's career spanned half a century during which he headlined 14 HBO comedy specials and appeared on "The Tonight Show" over 130 times, constantly evolving with the times and staying sharply resonant up until his death in 2008 and beyond. Carlin's ability to zoom in on societal ills has proven eerily prophetic and much of his work resonates today with alarming - and still hilarious - clarity. The documentary examines a cultural chameleon who is remembered as one of the most influential stand-up comics of all time.

name: Mo
summary: Mo Najjar straddles the line between two cultures, three languages and a ton of bullshit as a Palestinian refugee constantly living one step away from asylum on the path to U.S. citizenship. His family — including his resilient and spiritual mother, sister and older brother — flee to Houston, Texas. Laughing the pain away, Mo learns to adapt to his new world though getting ahead in life comes with several setbacks.

name: Hollywood Houselift with Jeff Lewis
summary: The famed interior designer is taking viewers into the homes of some of Hollywood's most familiar faces, and helping them transform their spaces.

name: Абсурд
summary: One general came up with a seemingly brilliant idea - to send real convicts on a trip to Russia, and to hire professional actors in their place, so that for a good fee they portrayed happy and contented prisoners during the inspection of the commission - but something like this it often goes wrong.

name: Female CEO Love Me
summary: Xia Meng Wei (Yang Xin Ying) is a female CEO who is domineering, intelligent, but often utters hurtful words. Uniquely, the CEO fell in love with Gu Yan (Cai Yi Jia) at first sight. Whereas Gu Yan was just a counter boy who had many skills. Xia Meng Wei tried various ways to win Gu Yan's heart. Did the CEO win the employee's heart?

name: Celebrity Lingo
summary: Celebrity Lingo will see famous faces go head-to-head in the fast-paced wordplay game, as they vie to fill in the blanks and find the missing words.

name: Doctor Lawyer
summary: Han Yi Khan was an elite surgeon. He graduated from the best medical school in South Korea and specialized in two departments: general surgery and cardiothoracic surgery. One operation changed his life. Khan Yi Khan believes that he underwent the operation well, but the patient died. Then his medical license was revoked. Four years later, Khan and Khan are working as a lawyer, specializing in medical litigation. He is also trying to uncover the truth about the death of his former patient. In their lawsuits, Khan and Khan defend the victims and try to punish those who commit medical error and negligence. He works with a prosecutor who lost a family member and a lover because of an operation that Khan and Khan performed.

name: Ishq Jalebi
summary: An unusual family reunion at Muhammad Boota's residence slowly escalates into a series of realizations, family bonding, and a chance of young love between Bela and Basim.

name: Chasing Famous
summary: An in-depth look at what it takes to make it to super stardom on social media - an intimate and unfiltered dive into one of Gen Z's most lucrative and sought after professions - being an "influencer". Stepping inside the UK's premier multi-million pound `influencer hub', The Wave House. The residence establishes itself on the global scene through TikTok, the third most-used social media platform with around 800 million global users.

name: Love in Flames of War
summary: Set in a tumultuous time of war, it revolves around a heart-wrenching romance between young marshal Xiao Bei Chen and a young maiden Lin Hang Jing.

name: Iron Chef: Quest for an Iron Legend
summary: In Iron Chef: Quest for an Iron Legend, five new Iron Chefs will compete against Challenger Chefs in the grandiose Kitchen Stadium. According to the official synopsis, "The competition's most successful Challenger will return to battle in a grand finale for the chance to be named the first ever ‘Iron Legend.'" Alton Brown returns as a host alongside Top Chef Season 10 winner Kristen Kish. Mark Dacascos is back as well, hopefully to shout out the secret ingredients this time around, too. And here's hoping that there's at least one cameo featuring original Iron Chef host Takeshi Kaga taking a big ol' bite out of a bell pepper.

name: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi
summary: Tales of the Jedi features parables built around Jedi from the prequel era. Journey into the lives of two distinctly different Jedi -- Ahsoka Tano and Count Dooku. Each will be put to the test as they make choices that will define their destinies.

name: Mathis Family Matters
summary: Mathis Family Matters follows Judge Mathis and his wife, Linda as two of their adult children move back to Los Angeles to all find their way and join the rest of the family. Judge Mathis has had great success helping others, but when it comes to his family, his opinions and being an "expert on everything" sometimes falls flat as he helps to guide his children through adulthood. Linda, the matriarch of the family, has a fabulous quick wit personality and since this is the first time the family has been under one roof in long time, it's her mission to keep everyone together through the ups and downs. The firstborn, Jade is living life to the fullest on both coasts, as she decides if her dreams of being a full-time motivational speaker outweigh her career in law. Camara can do no wrong in the eyes of the Judge, and with the nickname "Mother Mathis" she has started a family of her own along with her husband, Ryan and daughters Nora and Zara. Camara is trying to manage it all as she works on balancing family life and her law career. Greg Jr. and his long-term boyfriend, Elliott are busy working on multiple real estate ventures, and as they take their relationship to the next level they struggle with sharing their true bond with the world. The youngest, Amir is building his own production empire, and after a  recent divorce he jumps right back into another serious relationship causing his siblings to intercede with a love intervention. The Mathis crew is ready to shake things up with fun, big laughs and family love at the core.

name: Iosi, el espía arrepentido
summary: An intelligence officer, whose infiltration into the Jewish community could have been used to commit two terrorist attacks in his country, looks for justice before he and his family get killed.

name: Obliterated
summary: A special forces team thwarts a deadly plot in Sin City and parties accordingly. But when the real threat emerges, they must sober up to save Las Vegas.

name: MSNBC Prime
summary: The latest breaking news, reporting and live coverage of the day's important stories.

previousepisode.name: I Love People That Have A Mole

name: Dog's Best Friend
summary: We've all seen the quirky tabloid photos of dogs befriending turtles, elephants and birds. Dog's Best Friend captures the cutest of these uncanny canine acquaintances. Each episode tells the stories of different "odd couple" pairings from the animal world, reminding us that friendships come in all shapes and sizes!

name: Days Like These with Diesel
summary: Mark Lizotte, aka 'Diesel', revisits some of Australia's most seminal rock and country music concerts and the stories behind them. Learn about each exceptional, unforgettable concert, and what made them so special.

name: Meltdown: Three Mile Island
summary: Insiders recount the events, controversies and lingering effects of the accident at the Three Mile Island nuclear power plant in Pennsylvania.

name: Wild Babies
summary: Follow the adventures of baby lions, elephants, penguins, pangolins and more as they learn to navigate the highs and lows of life in the wild.

name: Крепость
summary: Film tells about Defense of Brest Fortress in June 1941, when Nazi Germany attacked USSR.

name: The One That Got Away
summary: It may seem like an impossible feat to track down The One That Got Away, but for these lucky singles, that dream becomes a reality. In this time-traveling, experimental dating series hosted by pop-icon, singer/songwriter Betty Who, six people searching for their soulmates are given the chance to explore a lifetime of missed connections as one by one, people from their pasts enter through "The Portal" to surprise them and take their shot at love.

name: Never Seen Again
summary: Never Seen Again focuses on a single case that starts with a gut punch, as a loved one recounts the last time they saw their son, daughter, brother, sister, boyfriend or girlfriend before they vanished into thin air. These are real mysteries about real people who have disappeared from families and relationships, abandoning lives, leaving only theories in their wake: Where did they go? Why? Did they run away, or were they the victims of foul play? Those left behind, heartbroken and shellshocked, struggle to solve the puzzle. Viewers are encouraged to join the search, to help the families find closure by contacting police departments and Crime Stoppers. Never Seen Again poses a crucial question: Someone out there knows something … Is it you?

previousepisode.name: Erin Brooks, A Target on My Back

name: Forever Summer: Hamptons
summary: Forever Summer: Hamptons is a coming-of-age docusoap, set against the idyllic backdrop of the Hamptons, about a group of college kids from widely different backgrounds, from wealthy New York City kids who descend for the summer, to the humble townies. By day, they're working at a seaside restaurant. By night, they are tearing up the town, testing friendships, and exploring love during the hottest days of the year. This group and their friends are chasing the perfect summer at a pivotal time in their lives, when carefree adolescence is about to end. Come September, the stakes and responsibilities will be high, but the summer is theirs for the taking.

name: Cosmic Love
summary: In this one-of-a-kind social experiment, four individuals attempt to find their perfect spouse via astrological matchmaking. Their romantic adventure takes place at a retreat run by a mystical guide, the Astro Chamber. They mingle, match, date, eliminate, and eventually make the biggest decision of their lives… will they marry their match, based solely on their astrology?

name: Mighty Little Bheem: Festival of Colors
summary: From surprising stage performances to spraying colors with friends, join baby Bheem for all his Holi hijinks during the special spring festival.

name: Mighty Little Bheem: Diwali
summary: From decorating his home to devouring sweets, join Bheem as he makes merry -- and a bit of mischief -- while the festival of lights is in full swing.

name: Mighty Little Bheem: Kite Festival
summary: With winter behind them, Bheem and his townspeople usher in a sunny new season in all their favorite ways during the Makar Sankranti festival.

name: The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
summary: Framed for a corporate crime, an adult Ted Templeton turns back into the Boss Baby to live undercover with his brother, Tim, posing as one of his kids.

name: Sesame Street Mecha Builders
summary: Mecha Builders reimagines the colorful neighborhood inhabitants of Seasme Street as heroes in a robot-animation style, otherwise known as Mechas.

name: The Only Girl You Haven't Seen
summary: A Qi, the daughter of the prime minister of Yan State, was framed by the third prince He Lian Chen and was murdered. After A Qi died, her body was thrown into the lake, but strangely It was Ah Qi who did not die. When she opened her eyes again, she found that her appearance and identity had become Leng Li, the daughter of General Leng Shao of Yanguo. Before A Qi, who had become Leng Li, had recovered, she was married to the mansion of He Lian Xuan, the fifth prince of the Yan Kingdom. Although He Lian Xuan looked a little honest, he was loyal and kind, and he was even more towards Leng Li. Gentle. In the days of getting along with He Lian Xuan day and night, Leng Li gradually fell in love with this "silly prince". The lives of Leng Li and He Lian Xuan were shaken by sudden changes again and again. The two could only face difficulties and dangers together. The sharing of joys and sorrows made their hearts closer, but Leng Li also discovered He Lian Xuan. The unknown side behind Lian Xuan.

name: To Be With You
summary: With the overall achievement of a well-off society in 2020 as the background, the theme is grand. But in storytelling, it is not from a grand perspective, but to explore the lives of ordinary people.

name: The Imperial Age
summary: The epic saga of Zhu Di's life, conquests, and, the rebellion to usurp the throne of the Ming Empire from his imperial nephew.

name: Motokare Retry
summary: Mitsu is a college student who has a trauma caused by her first boyfriend back in junior high school days. Mitsu wants to experience a new love but she suddenly reunites with her ex-boyfriend, Kaede, who has moved to an apartment next to hers. Five years has passed and Kaede has become more sophisticated but his gentle smile remains the same which makes Mitsu feels like she's falling in love with him again.

name: Red Flag Canal
summary: It follows the people of Lin County as they build the Red Flag Canal to remedy the water shortage problem that has plagued them for generations. In the summer and autumn season of 1959, Lin County suffered from a severe drought. Rivers, ponds and reservoirs dried up, crops withered leaving the people and livestock with no source of food and water. Under the leadership of the party secretary Yang Gui, a group of Linxian committee members are determined to get out of their long-time predicament. Thus, the project to build the Red Flag Canal was born.

name: Always With You
summary: The strong woman Li Na was originally the female boss of a cosmetics company, but her son Ding Yiyi, who was studying in Canada, was in constant condition, so she had to give up her job, and even disregarded the strong opposition of her husband Ding Zhiyuan, and chose to go to Canada to become a full-time employee.' accompany my mother.' However, behind the sacrifice of work and family, there are various realities such as the company's betrayal by subordinates, separation in different places, and emotional discord with her husband. Just when she was desperate, Li Na met Hu Yuanyuan, Xia Xia and Chen Lili, who were also accompanying mothers. They supported and depended on each other in their lives, and finally found a way to get along with her husband and children, and reached a life, love, and family relationship. reconciliation and growth.

name: Iron Housewives
summary: Mei Li , an interior designer born in the 1980s, Yilan , a business owner born in the 1970s, and Hao Weier , a fresh graduate of the post-90s generation, three women have become housewives either actively or passively. They formed an alliance, supported each other, and lived a beautiful life with both tenderness and pain: after overcoming difficulties such as high-mindedness, financial crisis, and her husband's unemployment, Mei Li changed from blind coping to light-heartedness, and finally cultivated into a good wife and good wife. mother; Yilan changed from a 'man's mother' to a 'woman's flower', which not only repaired the estrangement with her daughter, won the love of her mother-in-law, but also stabilized the unbalanced marriage; Hao Wei Er married investment bank boss Ma Guoqing . Later, living a boring 'golden bird' life, I realized that love can't come first, and finally chose to break through marriage and achieve my dream.

name: In the Name of the Law
summary: Xu Zhi Yi's wife was murdered in cold blood. The vice-captain of the crime investigation team dies while trying to save Xu Zhi Yi as he resisted arrest. This is a story about one wrongful conviction and two generations of prosecutors. Criminal investigator Ge Da Jie and his captain Chou Mu were under tight orders to crack the case involving Liu Sha Sha's death. All evidence point toward her husband Xu Zhi Yi as the culprit. Liu Sha Sha's mother also believes him to be the killer. When Chou Mu dies in pursuit of Xu Zhi Yi, Ge Da Jie despairs at the loss of a friend and grows firm in his belief that Xu Zhi Yi is the real killer.

name: Never Give Up
summary: The play tells the story of a group of young people who dare to think and fight in the tide of the times. No matter what difficulties they encounter, they never give up their original aspirations.

name: 一代洪商
summary: The story of Hunan businessmen who struggled to support half of the country from the Republic of China to the War of Resistance in the 20th century.

name: Festning Norge
summary: A near-future Norway has become a refuge for its citizens, sealed off from the chaos devastating the rest of the globe. But a deadly disease threatens this self-sufficient citadel, turning its defences into prison walls.

name: The Best Partner
summary: Luo Bing is a senior partner at Panorama Law Firm. He is a lawyer who cares only about winning cases. Dai Xi goes to his law firm to argue with him about her best friend's lawsuit and by chance becomes his assistant. At first, they don't get along, but soon they begin to understand each other and Dai Xi's respect for Luo Bing grows. Luo Bing also inherits some of Dai Xi's empathy for others and learns that practicing law is more than just winning. They both grow and become reliable partners in law.

name: Secrets of Size: Atoms to Supergalaxies
summary: In this mind-bending series, Jim Al-Khalili explores the vast range of size in the universe, from tiny atoms to gigantic, interconnected galaxies.

name: Jinxed at First
summary:
It revolves around a man who has come to terms with his unlucky fate and a goddess who has jumped into the real world to break her curse. Gong Soo Kwang, a brewmaster who runs a craft beer store. He is full of passion in his heart, but he always manages to keep calm and collected. Also equipped with a serious demeanor, he is a charming man who is popular among women wherever he goes. Lee Seul Bi is the goddess of fortune who meets Gong Soo Kwang and fights her own fate.


Adapted from the webtoon "The Jinx's Lover" (징크스의 연인) by writer Han Ji Hye (한지혜) and illustrator Gu Seul (구슬).

name: Cleaning Up
summary: The story of three cleaners: Eo Yong Mi, Ahn In Kyung, and Maeng Soo Ja at an financial company who resorts to insider trading, in order to feed their family and fulfil their dreams, after accidentally overhearing a piece of financial information.

name: I See You Again
summary: Ding Liao Liao, a new writer and director of Jiangxia TV's livelihood program, is enthusiastic and cheerful; Jiang Kan, a doctor of pharmacy, have little words and is indifferent. Two people with completely opposite personalities became roommates by chance. A series of wild incidents occurred between the two people who became intertwined with work and life. The two also went from being disliking each other at the beginning to understanding and opening up to each other. heart. Sharing the house is also younger brother, Ding Man, and ace anchor Lian Ge Yao who are enjoying a sweet love life which bud from a two-way crush. Two pairs of young men and women have created stories of large and small, humorous or delicate and warm in their daily life. The four hard-working protagonists will eventually work together to face the test of life and welcome every tomorrow.

name: Love in a Loop
summary: The rude and narcissistic boss Bai Zhen Xiang is constantly dying due to the dissatisfaction of his employees. Every time he dies, the time is reset to the same day, which causes his employee Lilu To be trapped in a time loop. To break out of the time loop, Lu Do had to make contact with Zhen Xiang, who drives her crazy, try her best to change him, save him, until she eventually falls in love with him.

name: Golden Mask
summary: Golden Mask tells the story of finding the answer to life in a mad fight between three women due to a tragedy caused by false desires and greed.

name: The Browns
summary: Tammie Brown juggles career and motherhood as the matriarch of a not so typical American household.

name: Around the World with Orson Welles
summary: In 1955, Orson Welles directed and hosted a mini series for British television. He leads us through a few famous places of Europe with his inimitable touch. Somewhere between a home movie and a cinematic essay, these short films have been described by French critics as the missing link in Welles' work.

name: Shoujiki Fudousan
summary: Nagase Saichi is the number one salesperson at a real estate agency whose biggest fault is being overly honest and unable to lie. Tsukishita Sakura is his junior.

name: 101 Places to Party Before You Die
summary: 101 Places to Party Before You Die follows comedians and longtime pals, Adam Pally and Jon Gabrus on an epic summer bromance. Accidental travel hosts, Pally and Gabrus, are given family-sanctioned three-day weekend escapes to venture across the U.S. to different destinations to experience everything they have to offer. Stepping off the beaten path, the guys champion the authenticities of each stop and share with viewers their love of the unexplored. Even after 15 years of friendship and adventure, there's still so much for them to discover from unique foods and drinks to local sites, and other idiosyncrasies that make each city tick. Locations featured include: Maui, Moab, Miami, Puerto Rico, Portland, Richmond, Atlanta and Denver.

name: Murai no Koi
summary: Tanaka Ayano, is a teacher who has been given the nickname "Iron Masked Girl, Tetsuko" by her students due to her not interfering her students more than necessary and not interacting with the other teachers. Tanaka is actually an otaku who fell in love with Hitotose, a character from an otome game. One day, Tanaka was confessed by her student, Murai. Tanaka immediately rejected Murai as she has never fell in love with a real man, let alone her student. However, the next day, Murai appears with a new hairstyle and he looks exactly like Hitotose.

name: 我的爱情撞上了战争
summary: The late 1930s. The story follows a fictional Chinese Secret Agent life and his romance with a doctor during the Battle of Songhu in Shanghai. The said battle is considered as one of the bloodiest battles China has witnessed during the period of Japanese invasion. The main protagonist is also seeking revenge for his sister's murder.

name: Decreed by Fate
summary: An imperial decree forces two strangers, a princess and a general, to become engaged. The princess does not care for the cold-faced general. Foreseeing divorce in her future, she decides to establish a "divorce office."

name: Li Da Bao's Ordinary Days
summary: After graduating from middle school, Li Da Bao directly went looking for a job to support his family since his father died early. Now he's responsible for repairing the machines in a textile factory. When Zhang Duo Duo, a performer in a song and dance troupe, goes to a spinning and weaving workshop, her hair gets stuck and Li Da Bao is the one to save her. He accompanies her to the song and dance troupe to report the incident, but accidentally bumps into Duo Duo while she's changing clothes. To save him from being viewed as a hoodlum, Duo Duo decides to marry Da Bao.

name: The King of Guns
summary: During the beginning of year 1945 in the Northeast region, Lu Yinghao returns from military school in the Soviet Union for his father's birthday celebrations at An Tai Hospital. He arrives just in time to witness the atrocities committed by the Japanese army as they slaughter innocents and takeover the hospital. Lu Yinghao plots revenge and crosses paths with Li Ruxue, a female warrior on a mission. Along the way, a bandit named Tong Xiaofeng falls in love at first sight with Lu Yinghao and steals important documents from him. Lu Yinghao strives to retrieve the documents but gets coerced into marrying Xiaofeng. Despite the obstacles, he continues on a path of being to be a hero of the people.

name: Sai Shang Feng Yun Ji
summary:
Set in the end of the Qing Dynasty, the drama chronicles the rise of the Chinese National Industry and Commerce against Western influences.

During the years of Guangxu's rule, the Zhangku Avenue of the Northern Silk Road managed by the Zhang family enjoyed great prosperity, and extended to the trading route of the Russians. However it all changed one day... Lu Junjie, son of the Zhang family, undergoes a huge family change and was forced to wander it the grasslands. He wanted to start anew, but the Qu family who stole his family's property never stopped trying to harm him. For their own interests, they allied with bandits and tied to kill him. Lu Junjie's closest ones fought to death to protect the Zhuangku Avenue. Gradually, more people chose to stand by Lu Junjie's side, helping him to repair the railways, build commercial radio; contributing greatly to the country's trade. After the Japanese Invasion of the Chinese, Lu Junjie fought his last batle against the Qu Tribe, and he was able to successfully avenge his family. With enemies out of the way, Lu Junjie believes that the former glory of the Zhangku Avenue would eventually be restored.

Online Playing Platform : CCTV, Youku, iQiyi, Tencent Video, pp Video

name: The City of the Family
summary:
After suffering from a devastating calamity due to the earthquake, the story set in Tangshan is an emotional journey about two households, three generations and nine people with different last names who come to form a family. In the year 1976, a magnitude 7.8 earthquake suddenly struck and buried Wang Da Ming and his wife beneath a pile of rubble. After six days and seven nights, Wang Da Ming is saved and upon gaining consciousness, he learns that his wife who was pregnant at the time and his father did not survive. Everywhere he looks, every household in the neighborhood grieves the loss of a family member. Wang Daming lives his days unable to recover from the incident when Yang Ai walks into his life. She is an ordinary worker for a ceramic factory. Yang Ai is orphaned. Her older sister also lost her family during the earthquake except for her youngest son who is mute. Because of their meeting, Wang Da Ming and Yang Ai gradually become family to each other and they try to pick up the pieces to make a new home.

 

Online broadcast : Hunan TV , IQIYI , Tencent Video , Youku

name: Cinderella Complex
summary: Sakamura Mahiro, an employee at the high-class old inn known as 'Kataoka', has an ambition to marry a rich man and live a comfortable life because of her previous relationship. Her goal is to find her 'ideal prince' with money, honesty, and values in a marriage partner that she will not negotiate on. While working at Kataoka, she comes to meet Kouya, Yugo and Keiichi as she searches for her ideal partner...

name: The Scale of Desire
summary: Xiao Jian, director of Economic Investigation Division, investigates a mysterious financial case led by financial tycoon Xu Feng and consequently finds that a transnational money-laundering group is involved. Xiao Jian gets the diary of Xu Feng by accident and finds out Xu Feng's hidden identity. Faced with a strong enemy and the pressure from his superior, Xiao Jian still investigates the case unswervingly with a strong sense of responsibility and mission.

name: Reel Britannia
summary: A bold, ambitious and visually striking documentary which explores British film decade-by-decade from 1960 through to the noughties, narrated by comedian Nick Helm. Featuring a collection of brand-new archival interviews, alongside behind the scenes footage, Reel Britannia will take viewers on a journey through the evolution of British cinema.

name: Momolu & Friends
summary: Created by artist Leena Frediksson, Momolu and Friends follows a panda and his friends as they use art to solve problems they encounter.

name: To.Two
summary: To.two is an extremely popular social media app with a catch; you can only get in based on invite. This web drama explores how this app creates social barriers between the students based on who can access the invite.

name: King Rex
summary: King Rex explores a buried treasure of a true-crime mystery — how a North Texas kingdom got itself smashed to pieces by a judge's gavel, the IRS and the FBI.

name: Нулевые
summary: A documentary project by Sergei Minaev about a decade in which we could do everything, and the sweet life seemed to never end. The historical anthology series will be a direct continuation of the "Nineties". The inhabitants of a country that is gradually recovering from long years of permissiveness are assimilated into a different market paradigm and, with incredible enthusiasm, begin to try on new models of production and consumption. Oil prices are prohibitively high, Isinbayeva sets records, Bilan wins Eurovision, and Kovalchuk scores a goal against Canadians in the final of the Ice Hockey World Championship. Episodes of the series will present different sections of the decade: Night Watch and The Last Hero, Dom-2 and Star Factory, the Centr group and the revolution in Russian rap, the madness of nightlife and economic euphoria. The key heroes of the era: Konstantin Ernst and Ksenia Sobchak, Dima Bilan and Alexei Kudrin, Konstantin Khabensky and Timur Bekmambetov will tell about how life was arranged in the 2000s.

name: Mr. Good? Gåten Eirik Jensen
summary: In this riveting docuseries, when Norway's top cop is suspected of drug trafficking, investigators must ask: Is he a good officer or a major criminal?

name: Lunch
summary: A series for anyone who has, wishes they had, or is overjoyed that they don't have a job. Based on the cartoon by Børge Lund.

name: Best of Britain by the Sea
summary: Ainsley Harriott and Grace Dent explore some of the best seaside destinations and dishes the British Isles has to offer.

name: War of Y
summary: Real war is not weapons, but people. This is a representation of the feeling from a war raging with cunning, resentment and betrayal.

previousepisode.name: Wife #5 - The World Keeps Turning, No Matter What

name: Luz María
summary: Luz María is a simple and naive country girl, whose mother Rosa is very sick. They decide to go to Lima in order for Rosa to get better. The two women reside in an old family friend, named Modesta and her son Sergio. Modesta is a cook for the rich and influential family Mendoza. Lucecita dreams of the day when she'll return to the country. Unfortunately Rosa's health worsens and a secret she kept all her life makes her to ask Modesta for help. Modesta manages to convince her employer, Miguel de Mendoza, who happens to be Rosa's only love to visit the sick woman for the last time. When Miguel sees Rosa after so many years she unravels that he is Lucecita's father and gets him to vow to look after his illegitimate daughter. After Rosa's death, haunted by the promise he gave, Miguel decides to let Lucecita live in his mansion but as a maid clueless to her origin. Grateful to the kind gentleman from her mother's past, Lucecita does everything to get the approval of Miguel's despotic wife, Graciela and his invalid daughter, Angelina. By that time Lucecita starts to bond with Angelina's handsome but unhappy husband, Gustavo. He is well known for his noble and charitable personality and that is enough to win Lucecita's heart forever.

name: The Reckoning
summary: The Reckoning will explore how Jimmy Savile used his celebrity and powerful connections to conceal his crimes and exploit institutional failings. It is important to understand how he was able to hide in plain sight in order to gain a greater understanding of how he evaded justice. The drama aims to highlight the importance of confronting the horrors of the past and talking openly about abuse.

name: Tractor World
summary: Getting to grips with the biggest, fastest and most powerful tractors on the planet, including those in Alaska, Florida and the UK.

name: Love in the Jungle
summary: Fed up with the modern dating world, sexy singles embrace their animal instincts and compete to find a mate in this wild social experiment that asks: can humans learn a thing or two from the animal kingdom's tried and true mating rituals?

name: Super Monsters Monster Pets
summary: The adorably magical Monster Pets star in a series of short adventures that are big on fun -- and full of surprises!

name: Rafa Nadal Academy
summary: See what life is like at the Rafa Nadal Academy by Movistar through some of the most promising tennis players in the world. Live an entire season with eight junior and professional players. Training, tournaments, and education under Rafa Nadal's supervision. Accomplishments, failures, injuries, and dreams for which everyone works at the Manacor education and high-performance sports center.

name: Les gens de Mogador
summary: From 1850 to 1925, in the tumult of passions and wars, three generations of women will have the heavy responsibility of managing the estate of Mogador, in Provence. When Julia marries Rodolphe Vernet, heir to the Mogador estate, she is far from imagining the terrible work that awaits her...

name: Sarah - La ragazza di Avetrana
summary: On August 26, 2010, the young Sarah Scazzi mysteriously disappears. After 42 days of searching, a sad truth is discovered.

name: Made for Murder
